notes: The catalog text prints only the A.S. in Veterinary Technology section; it contains no Certificate of Achievement section for Veterinary Technology, so no blocks were recorded for the certificate. Reviewer should check whether the certificate exists elsewhere in the catalog or whether the state file's award type corresponds to the A.S. program.

For reference, the A.S. section requires all of VT 100 (3), VT 111 (4), VT 152 (2), VT 110 (3), VT 113 (4), VT 120 (4), VT 122 (3), VT 126 (1.5), VT 123 (3), VT 130 (4), VT 131 (3), VT 134 (1.5), and VT 298 (0.5-4; VT 298 not in closed list), with 'Total Units: 36.5 - 40' for the major, plus Local GE or Cal-GETC and electives to reach at least 60 units. Unit figures in the PDF are fused with footnote numbers (e.g., '31' = 3 units, footnote 1).
Footnote 13 states VT 298 requires a minimum of 300 hours (4-5 total units) of work experience, which conflicts with the printed 0.5-4 range.
